schema.name: comp_marks
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE comp_marks (comp_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fav INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: engine_log
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE engine_log (at INTEGER, region TEXT, level TEXT, message TEXT)

schema.name: kv
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE kv (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: match_queue
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE match_queue (
  match_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  route     TEXT NOT NULL,
  platform  TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed_rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0   -- 0 pending, 1 stored, 2 skipped
)

schema.name: match_stored
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE match_stored (  -- when each match was stored, for matches per hour (E10)
  match_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL,
  at       INTEGER NOT NULL
)

schema.name: match_stored_at
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX match_stored_at ON match_stored(at, platform)

schema.name: matches
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE matches (
  match_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  platform      TEXT NOT NULL,
  patch         TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_number    INTEGER,
  game_datetime INTEGER NOT NULL,
  game_length   REAL,
  rank          INTEGER NOT NULL,         -- rank of the player this match was found through
  queue_id      INTEGER                   -- Riot's queue (1100 ranked); NULL for matches stored before E12, all ranked
)

schema.name: matches_patch
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX matches_patch ON matches(patch, rank)

schema.name: my_matches
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE my_matches (match_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, game_datetime INTEGER NOT NULL, json TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: participants
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE participants (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  match_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  puuid      TEXT NOT NULL,
  placement  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  level      INTEGER,
  last_round INTEGER,
  gold_left  INTEGER,
  damage     INTEGER,
  comp_key   TEXT                          -- "main trait|carry unit", see src/cluster.ts
)

schema.name: participants_match
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX participants_match ON participants(match_id)

schema.name: players
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE players (
  puuid        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  platform     TEXT NOT NULL,
  tier         TEXT NOT NULL,
  rank         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_crawled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

schema.name: players_next
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX players_next ON players(platform, last_crawled, rank DESC)

schema.name: queue_pending
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX queue_pending ON match_queue(route, status)

schema.name: rank_sample_pending
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX rank_sample_pending ON rank_sample_queue(done, platform)

schema.name: rank_sample_queue
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rank_sample_queue (match_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, platform TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: rank_samples
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rank_samples (match_id TEXT, puuid TEXT, tier TEXT, division TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (match_id, puuid))

schema.name: saved_teams
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE saved_teams (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, board TEXT NOT NULL, created INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: units
